title: Claude Entity Analyst
short: Ask Claude what a page is about — entities stated or implied, relationships, attribute gaps, the real subject and naming problems — in one fixed shape, then check every answer against the page text.
cost: About a cent or two per page with Claude Sonnet 5.5; less with Haiku 4.5
inputs: Paste one page's main content, or upload a crawl export with a URL column and a content column. Optional: the Entity Extractor's entity_mentions.csv
outputs: Entities with confidence tiers, relationships, attribute gaps and naming issues, as CSV and JSON
how: Paste your Anthropic key. It stays in this tab and is sent only to Anthropic.
Choose an analysis: entity map, attribute gaps, subject check, or naming and ambiguity.
Paste one page's main content (or upload your crawl CSV) and set the intended entity.
Check the price estimate, then run it. Start with one page before a whole crawl.
Read the tiers: use Solid and Likely rows, review Candidates, never use Discards. Export the CSVs.
note: An LLM can name entities that are not on the page. Every quote is checked against your text automatically — that check is the point of the tool, so never skip the tier column.
